mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward. Local and development testing uses self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off. Connections use HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exception, because certificate management is now in place.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md
